svg.title: Keel: governed runtime and audit chain

g.text: One brief in; a governed, audited agent out. Figures 1–10 on one spine
CLIENT SURFACE the model sees only these meta-tools
run_flow one call, a server-side graph
the model is not called for intermediate nodes
BRIEF + HANDLE compact context, lossless payload
TRIGGERS two entry points, one governed flow
ENFORCEMENT every call crosses one path
catalog entries are not proof of live supplier availability
each record links to the one before it
Schematic composition of Figures 1–10. Cells denote fields and tools, not counts.
Motion traces connections; it is not live execution data or a test result.
